ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.05:0.95 ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity field with discrete, high-contrast white pixel clusters (mottling) localized in the upper-medial region of the left lobe and near the trailing edge of the right lobe. A distinct linear high-intensity mark is mapped vertically on the right lobe's mid-section.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Symmetrical V-shaped notch with an estimated pixel angle of 32 degrees and a vertical depth comprising approximately 25% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations present along the entire continuous trailing edge boundary. Pixel amplitude of peaks ranges from 5-15 pixels, with higher density observed on the distal margins of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the leading edges transitioning to a sharp, posteriorly-oriented taper at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, high-contrast circular pixel clusters (white) detected on the upper quadrant of the left lobe and near the apex of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, prominent vertical linear disruption (approx. 180 pixels in length) on the right lobe; multiple smaller, faint linear pixel disruptions oriented horizontally near the medial notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct vertical linear abrasion on the right lobe; irregular white scarring/pigmentation patches visible along the interior perimeter of the trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Elongated and acutely pointed distal lobe tips (apexes) relative to the overall lobe width.
